rules.title: SAE Initial Reporting Delay (>24h)
rules.rationale_template: Serious Adverse Event {record_id} ({extra}) was reported {observed}h after site awareness, exceeding the mandatory 24-hour pharmacovigilance reporting window.
rules.recommended_action: Contact Principal Investigator and Safety Coordinator immediately to file expedited initial SAE narrative and document root cause of reporting delay.

rules.title: SAE Follow-Up Cycle Time Breach (>7d Target)
rules.rationale_template: SAE {record_id} follow-up packet has been open or took {observed} days, breaching the 7-day System-of-Action cycle-time target.
rules.recommended_action: Schedule targeted medical record source review with site coordinator within 48 hours to close outstanding safety follow-up queries.

rules.title: Extended SAE Open Lag (>21d Baseline Risk)
rules.rationale_template: SAE {record_id} cycle time reached {observed} days, approaching the legacy 28-day manual bottleneck and creating regulatory inspection exposure.
rules.recommended_action: Escalate to Medical Monitor and Quality Assurance; issue formal safety compliance action item prior to next subject randomization.

rules.title: Unassessed Causality on Grade 3+ Event
rules.rationale_template: CTCAE Grade 3+ event {record_id} ({extra}) lacks Principal Investigator causality attribution.
rules.recommended_action: Request Principal Investigator electronic signature on AE causality attribution in EDC/Safety portal.

rules.title: Site High-Grade AE Cluster (>=2 Grade 3+ Events)
rules.rationale_template: Site recorded {observed} Grade 3+ adverse events across active subjects, warranting cross-subject dosing and concomitant medication review.
rules.recommended_action: Review subject dosing logs and concomitant medications during upcoming monitoring visit to rule out site-specific administration error.

rules.title: Outdated ICF Version Not Re-Consented
rules.rationale_template: Subject visit record {record_id} reflects signed ICF {observed} while active study protocol requires {extra}.
rules.recommended_action: Halt non-safety protocol procedures for affected subject until IRB-approved current ICF version is executed and documented.

rules.title: Screening Procedure Prior to ICF Signature
rules.rationale_template: Visit {record_id} indicates screening assessment date ({observed}) occurred prior to ICF signature date ({extra}), constituting a critical GCP violation.
rules.recommended_action: File Major Protocol Deviation, notify IRB/IEC per local SOP, and conduct immediate re-training on informed consent workflow.

rules.title: Unverified ICF Source Documentation
rules.rationale_template: Visit record {record_id} has unverified original informed consent documentation pending 100% CRA source verification.
rules.recommended_action: Add 100% ICF wet-ink/eConsent audit for affected subject to the next on-site or remote monitoring visit agenda.

rules.title: Multi-Subject Amendment Re-Consent Backlog
rules.rationale_template: Site has {observed} enrolled subjects still operating under superseded consent versions following protocol amendment.
rules.recommended_action: Audit site regulatory binder to confirm IRB approval of latest amendment and establish a 7-day re-consent tracking schedule.

rules.title: Expired GCP Certification on Active Staff
rules.rationale_template: Site staff role {extra} ({record_id}) has an expired GCP certification ({observed} days past expiration) while listed on active delegation log.
rules.recommended_action: Suspend delegated trial duties for uncertified staff member immediately until renewed GCP certificate is uploaded to eTMF.

rules.title: Expired Protocol Amendment Training
rules.rationale_template: Training record {record_id} ({extra}) is overdue by {observed} days relative to amendment implementation deadline.
rules.recommended_action: Send LMS training completion link and require Principal Investigator attestation before next subject visit.

rules.title: Imminent Certification Expiration (<=14d)
rules.rationale_template: Certification {record_id} ({extra}) expires in {observed} days.
rules.recommended_action: Include proactive renewal reminder in weekly site follow-up email to prevent delegation lapse.

rules.title: Incomplete EDC/IRT System Training
rules.rationale_template: Staff training module {record_id} ({extra}) remains INCOMPLETE, delaying backup coordinator system provisioning.
rules.recommended_action: Follow up with backup study coordinator to complete LMS module and provision EDC/IRT role access.

rules.title: Critical eCRF Query Aging (>21d)
rules.rationale_template: Visit record {record_id} contains unresolved EDC data queries aged {observed} days (>21-day threshold).
rules.recommended_action: Conduct targeted query resolution call with site data coordinator to clear aged discrepancies prior to database snapshot.

rules.title: Elevated eCRF Query Aging (15-21d)
rules.rationale_template: Visit record {record_id} has open queries aged {observed} days approaching critical SLA breach.
rules.recommended_action: Flag open queries in routine site follow-up digest for coordinator review.

rules.title: High Open Query Density (>=5 per Subject)
rules.rationale_template: Visit record {record_id} accumulated {observed} open eCRF queries, indicating systematic eCRF completion errors.
rules.recommended_action: Provide refresher coaching on eCRF completion guidelines for laboratory units and concomitant therapy dates.

rules.title: Source Data Verification Backlog (>25 Pages)
rules.rationale_template: Visit record {record_id} has {observed} unverified eCRF pages awaiting CRA source data verification.
rules.recommended_action: Allocate dedicated remote EHR/SDV block or extend upcoming on-site monitoring duration by 0.5 days.

rules.title: Overdue Visit eCRF Data Entry
rules.rationale_template: Completed clinic visit {record_id} ({extra}) has not been transcribed into EDC within the 5-business-day SLA.
rules.recommended_action: Confirm subject visit occurrence with coordinator and request eCRF entry within 72 hours.

rules.title: Site Enrollment Severely Below Target (<40%)
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} achieved {observed}% of target enrollment ({extra}), trailing study recruitment trajectory.
rules.recommended_action: Review local EHR pre-screening funnel in the Trial Selection Workbench and route matched local candidates to site.

rules.title: Elevated Screen Failure Rate (>55%)
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} exhibits a {observed}% screen failure rate ({extra}), suggesting pre-screening biomarker misalignment.
rules.recommended_action: Align site pre-screening checklist with Trial Selection Workbench biomarker & organ-function thresholds.

rules.title: Stalled Site Screening Activity (>30d)
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} has logged {observed} days without a new candidate screening event.
rules.recommended_action: Conduct recruitment barrier check-in with Principal Investigator and share matched candidate IDs from regional registry.

rules.title: Early Subject Withdrawal Alert
rules.rationale_template: Subject record {record_id} ({extra}) documented early study withdrawal; end-of-treatment safety follow-up must be verified.
rules.recommended_action: Verify completion of Early Termination eCRF page and 30-day safety follow-up assessment.

rules.title: Unscreened Local Eligible Candidate Pool (>=3)
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} has {observed} fully eligible synthetic candidates in its catchment pool ready for screening outreach.
rules.recommended_action: Export candidate eligibility packet from Trial Selection Workbench for site screening coordinator review.

rules.title: Unresolved Cold-Chain Temperature Excursion
rules.rationale_template: IRT inventory at {record_id} reports an unresolved cold-chain temperature excursion ({extra} total excursions), risking quarantine of investigational product.
rules.recommended_action: Quarantine affected kits in IRT immediately, upload temperature logger data to Sponsor Pharmacy, and pause new dosing until stability clearance.

rules.title: Drug Kit Inventory Below Buffer Minimum
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} holds {observed} available IP kits against a minimum buffer requirement of {extra} kits.
rules.recommended_action: Trigger emergency depot resupply order in IRT before scheduling upcoming subject randomization or maintenance dosing visits.

rules.title: Low Kit Buffer Without Transit Resupply
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} is within 2 kits of minimum buffer ({observed} kits) with zero automated resupply shipments in transit.
rules.recommended_action: Verify IRT auto-resupply trigger settings with clinical supply manager.

rules.title: Randomization-to-First-Dose Lag (>5d)
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} exhibits a {observed}-day median delay from IRT randomization to initial IP administration (>5.0d protocol window).
rules.recommended_action: Coordinate pharmacy preparation scheduling with clinic infusion/dispensing calendar.

rules.title: Major Protocol Deviation Open >14 Days
rules.rationale_template: Major Protocol Deviation {record_id} ({extra}) has remained open for {observed} days without PI sign-off and closure.
rules.recommended_action: Review root-cause narrative with Principal Investigator and finalize deviation closure record in CTMS/eTMF.

rules.title: Unclosed Protocol Deviation Requiring CAPA
rules.rationale_template: Protocol Deviation {record_id} ({extra}) requires mandatory CAPA implementation and remains open ({observed} days).
rules.recommended_action: Draft formal CAPA plan with site quality lead and verify effectiveness check timeline before next monitoring sign-off.

rules.title: Overdue Site CAPA Remediation
rules.rationale_template: QMS Quality Issue {record_id} ({extra}) has an overdue CAPA milestone open for {observed} days.
rules.recommended_action: Escalate overdue CAPA evidence collection during site monitoring call and update QMS remediation tracker.

rules.title: Monitoring Visit Cadence Overdue (>60d)
rules.rationale_template: Site {record_id} has gone {observed} days since last monitoring visit ({extra}), exceeding the 60-day monitoring plan cadence.
rules.recommended_action: Generate Monitoring Visit Agenda immediately and confirm on-site/remote visit dates within the next 10 business days.

rules.title: Out-of-Window Subject Visit Drift (>5d)
rules.rationale_template: Subject visit {record_id} occurred {observed} days outside the protocol target window.
rules.recommended_action: Remind site coordinator to use protocol visit window calculator when booking follow-up appointments.
